Zero artifacts_* pane-brief failures — sase-u6.5.1's stitches repair fully covers the pane-description residue; no additional golden updates needed. All 356 non-artifacts failures fall within the extensively corroborated sase-r5 standing renderer-drift backlog (334-381 failed range across 15+ independent measurements this week); none touch the Artifacts sub-tab. One collection ERROR (test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_metadata_search.py, broken _zoom_agent import from commit f4b827af6) is new/distinct, unrelated to sase-r5 and sase-u6 — recorded as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note, not fixed here.
